Definition: Integration of CRVS data (births, deaths, marriages) into data exchange for real-time verification and service eligibility
Comments: Civil registration managed through civil registry offices coordinated by Ministry of Territorial Administration (World Bank WURI PAD). WURI project aims to connect civil registration with human development services. Current CRVS systems largely paper-based or limited digital; birth registration rate low. Integration with data exchange not confirmed as operational.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Original WURI source confirmed but corroborated with newer evidence: the iCivil CRVS system is piloted with interoperability to health facilities in some communes (birth registration within legal deadline only 60.65%, 2024), and a draft Code des personnes et de la famille debated in the legislature in September 2025 proposes a unique civil-status identifier and digital registers, while a 2025-2028 AMADE/DGMEC project is only now piloting automated birth-registration interoperability with health services in three municipalities. This is active work-in-progress rather than a mere plan, so the code is raised from 2 to 3 (Under development); full national data-exchange integration is not yet evidenced.

Definition: Integration of learner records, academic credentials, enrollment data, and scholarship/bursary systems
Comments: Education sector identified as target for PACTDIGITAL (World Bank project includes education). Digital skills training. No confirmed learner records/credentials integration with national data exchange platform.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Corroborated with newer, more specific evidence: a national student registry (Fichier National des Élèves / FIUE-BF) already enrols pupils and issues school ID cards, and a June 2025 meeting between the Digital Transition and Basic Education ministers plus a November 2025 'stratégie de généralisation du FNE' document show active work, supported by the WURI project, to scale the registry nationally and build interoperability. This is beyond a mere plan, so the code is raised from 2 to 3 (Under development); full integration into a cross-government data exchange platform is not yet evidenced.

Definition: Integration of driver's license registration and traffic offence data
Comments: Driver licensing and vehicle registration under transport authorities. 69 digital platforms set up in 2025 includes some transport-related services. No specific evidence of driver licensing integration with national data exchange system. Digitisation of transport services planned under PACTDIGITAL.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed at 2 (Planned): the transport ministry's DGTTM launched a public portal (dgttmverif.bf, March 2024) to verify vehicle registration, and driving licences/vehicle cards have been reissued as secure biometric documents under a long-running PPP, but no evidence was found that this system is integrated into a cross-government data exchange platform. The original single source is corroborated by an independent report; no basis found to raise the code.

Definition: Integration of passport issuance and immigration control data into the exchange platform
Comments: New generation e-passport launched September 3, 2024 - first country in West Africa to adopt polycarbonate-based data page (EMPTECH system). Advanced registration/application system with AI-powered biometric enrollment. ICAO-compliant. Biometric passport issuance system comprehensive. Integration with MOSIP ID and national systems being developed.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed at 4: beyond the 2024 e-passport, Burkina Faso adopted a new AES-harmonised biometric ID card (CIB-AES, decree of 6 November 2025) that government and press sources describe as designed to enable an 'interoperability system' supporting cross-border and domestic digital government services, alongside a common AES e-passport. Rollout is explicitly phased over five years, so full integration is not yet complete, consistent with 'partially integrated'. Original score corroborated with two additional authoritative sources; no change to the code.

Definition: Integration of statistics, census data, administrative data for planning, M&E, and evidence-based policymaking
Comments: INSD (National Statistics Institute) participates in Enhanced General Data Dissemination System (e-GDDS) and publishes data on National Summary Data Page (IMF 2024). Budget execution reports published quarterly online. No confirmed statistics/census data integration with government data exchange platform.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: IMF source could not be re-verified (link timed out) so it is not counted as confirming evidence on its own. Newer sources show concrete, active integration work: DGI's 2025-2027 operational plan includes a specific action to upgrade the technical interfaces between DGI and INSD, and INSD's 2026-2030 strategic plan plus its September 2025 geospatial Système d'Information des Localités show ongoing efforts to integrate census/administrative data for territorial planning. This is work-in-progress rather than merely planned, so the code is raised from 2 to 3 (Under development); a fully operational, general-purpose data exchange has not been confirmed.

Definition: Integration of tax administration and revenue collection systems data into the exchange platform
Comments: DGI and DGD (tax and customs) IT systems identified for data matching under IMF 2024 reform agenda. N@folo IFMIS (Integrated Financial Management System) under development. Biometric enrollment of civil servants to eliminate ghost workers from SIGASPE payroll (2024 IMF Article IV). Digitalization of tax and customs procedures being scaled up. Some integration in progress.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: IMF source could not be re-verified (link timed out). Newer, more advanced evidence found: the Sylvie 2 single-window customs platform (operational since 17 February 2025) integrates e-payment, e-signature and an improved interface with the SYDONIA customs system across 13 dematerialised procedures spanning multiple administrations; DGI's 17 sites are interconnected via the RESINA network with a unique taxpayer identifier (IFU) and an ongoing DGI-INSD interface upgrade; and the Treasury's LANAYA/e-BDT platforms (launched April 2026) digitise treasury-taxpayer transactions. This constitutes operational integration beyond 'under development', so the code is raised from 3 to 4 (Partially integrated).
